product_overview: BGC Assist is a responsive web platform that enables users to quickly access road assistance, emergency services, and insurance support digitally. It offers a highly performant, mobile-first interface for service requests, policy checks, and information about insurance products.
core_goals: Provide fast and simple digital access to emergency road assistance services such as towing, battery support, and locksmith services.
Enable users to submit multi-step service request applications with validation and location tracking.
Allow users to check their insurance policy limits and remaining benefits through an intuitive progress bar visualization.
Offer a secure admin panel with role-based access control for managing all site content, including packages, services, sliders, applications, and settings.
Ensure high responsiveness and accessibility across all devices using Tailwind CSS and follow WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
Implement SEO best practices with structured data, sitemap, and robots.txt for search engine visibility.
key_features: Mobile-first responsive design with Tailwind CSS ensuring smooth UI on devices ranging from iPhone SE to 4K monitors.
Multi-step online assistance request form with fields for vehicle plate, national ID, GPS/manual location input, problem selection, and confirmation message.
Admin authentication with roles SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, and EDITOR to securely manage site content.
Comprehensive CRUD management for road assistance packages and services accessible to public for browsing and purchase.
Hero slider management with image upload via Vercel Blob and content editing capabilities.
Email notifications sent through Resend API for application events and communication.
Location, vehicle brand, and category data APIs used to populate form dropdowns dynamically.
Global search and notification system within the admin panel for efficient content management.
Detailed statistics API to provide metrics on application counts and other relevant KPIs.
SEO optimization with structured data embedded for better search engine indexing and user experience.
user_flow_summary: User lands on the homepage greeted by a hero section with a headline and a prominent 'Call for Help Now' call-to-action button.
User browses service cards that display road assistance options like towing, replacement vehicle, and home assistance with icons.
User initiates a multi-step service request form: inputs vehicle plate and ID number, then shares location via GPS or manual entry.
User selects the type of issue (Breakdown, Accident, Out of Fuel) from a dropdown menu.
User reviews a summary of the request and submits it, receiving a confirmation message indicating rescue teams have been dispatched.
Users can check their remaining insurance or assistance package limits after login, presented with progress bars.
Admin users securely login to the admin panel, manage content such as packages, services, sliders, applications, and site settings with role restrictions.
Admin can create, edit, delete packages and services, upload images for sliders, and manage user notifications and search queries.
System sends email notifications upon application submissions and other key events.
Public users access contact options including sticky call button and WhatsApp chat integration easily accessible throughout the site.
validation_criteria: All form inputs require strict validation such as license plate format (no spaces or special characters) and mandatory location data if GPS permissions are denied.
Loading states are implemented with skeleton loaders or spinners during data fetching or API calls.
Graceful error messages are shown for API failures, e.g., when policy data cannot be retrieved, instructing users to call support.
Admin role-based access control correctly restricts permissions and inabilities based on roles SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, and EDITOR.
Responsive design passes tests across all device viewports with no UI breakage or overflow issues.
Email sending functionality is verified through integration tests with Resend API confirming notifications are received.
File uploads for slider images and other content comply with expected formats and storage via Vercel Blob.
SEO best practices are verified with correct structured data, sitemap generation, and robots.txt deployment.
Accessibility audits ensure all buttons have aria-labels and color contrasts meet WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.

features.name: Authentication & Admin Panel
features.description: Admin authentication system with role-based access control (SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, EDITOR). Admin panel for managing all site content.

features.name: Package Management
features.description: CRUD operations for road assistance packages. Admin can create, edit, delete packages. Public can view and purchase packages.

features.name: Service Management
features.description: CRUD operations for road assistance services (towing, battery, tire, fuel, etc.). Admin manages services, public views them.

features.name: Application/Form Management
features.description: Package purchase application form system. Users fill multi-step form, applications are stored and emails are sent.

features.name: Slider Management
features.description: Hero slider management system. Admin can create, edit, delete slider items with images and content.

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Site settings management (contact info, social media, working hours). Admin can update settings, public can view them.

features.name: Email Service
features.description: Email sending service using Resend API. Sends application notifications and other emails.

features.name: File Upload
features.description: File upload service using Vercel Blob. Handles image uploads for sliders and other content.

features.name: Public Website Sections
features.description: Public-facing website sections including hero, stats, services, packages, features, and CTA sections.

features.name: API Utilities & Validation
features.description: API utility functions, validation helpers, and error handling for all API routes.

features.name: Location Data
features.description: City and district data management. Provides location data for forms and applications.

features.name: Vehicle Brands Data
features.description: Vehicle brand and category data for application forms.

features.name: Admin Search & Notifications
features.description: Global search functionality and notifications system for admin panel.

features.name: Statistics API
features.description: Statistics endpoint for admin dashboard showing application counts and metrics.

features.name: SEO & Structured Data
features.description: SEO optimization with structured data (Schema.org), sitemap, and robots.txt.
